data.body:
AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F4 critical + gap-analysis #4 #5):

**Plan-review F4 — REWRITE: GitHub Actions check-contexts are JOB-level, not STEP-level**. The 'umbrella step' concept is wrong. Implement as a single new JOB in ci.yml whose 'name:' field IS the stable check-context. Branch protection requires that job name. Steps within the job may be conditional (only run scan when base==main && head matches session/**), but the JOB always runs and reports a stable name. The check-context registered in required-checks.txt is the JOB's name field verbatim.

**Plan-review F5 — bootstrap resolved**: GitHub runs pull_request workflows from PR HEAD's workflow file (refs/pull/N/merge). The first PR that adds the workflow file ALSO runs it. No special bootstrap phase needed.

**Gap-analysis #3 SHA capture at job-start**: The job's FIRST step captures \${github.event.pull_request.head.sha} and \${github.event.pull_request.base.sha} into env vars; all subsequent steps receive these via env, not via re-reading event fields (avoids race).

**Gap-analysis #4 override/exemption**: Implement an override mechanism for intentional RED markers. Prefer: a header-line allowlist in .test-index of the form '# DEFERRED: <path>:<test_name> reason=<text> ticket=<id>'. When a marker matches an exemption, scanner logs 'WARN: RED marker <path>:<test_name> intentionally deferred (ticket=<id>) — not blocking' and does NOT exit non-zero. Both blocking and exempt markers are listed in the job output.

**Gap-analysis #5 S5 coordination**: Before committing ci.yml changes, 'git fetch origin' and verify whether S5 has staged changes to ci.yml. Add the new job as a SELF-CONTAINED block (own 'jobs:' entry); minimize textual overlap with existing job sections. If S5's branch lands first, rebase on it.

Additional AC items:
- [ ] ci.yml contains a NEW job (not a new step within an existing job) with stable name field
  Verify: yq '.jobs | keys | .[]' .github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -qE 'red-test-blocker|merge-pipeline'
- [ ] required-checks.txt contains the job's exact 'name:' field value
  Verify: NAME=$(yq '.jobs["merge-pipeline-checks"].name // ""' .github/workflows/ci.yml) && grep -qF "$NAME" .github/required-checks.txt
- [ ] SHAs captured at job-start (first step) into env vars
  Verify: grep -qE 'BASE_SHA.*github.event.pull_request.base.sha' .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] Override mechanism documented in .test-index header or workflow logic
  Verify: grep -qE 'DEFERRED.*ticket=|override.*marker' .github/workflows/ci.yml plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh
- [ ] No textual conflict with existing ci.yml jobs (self-contained block)
  Verify: actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml
